On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of…

people.name: Baana
people.line: A man who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.

people.name: Berechiah
people.line: Israelite who helped repair Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Hakkoz
people.line: A priest who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.

people.name: Meremoth
people.line: A priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.

people.name: Meshezabel
people.line: One who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.

people.name: Meshullam
people.line: Helped repair the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah.

people.name: Uriah

people.name: Zadok
people.line: Repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall

translations.web: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.
translations.bsb: Next to them, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, made repairs. Next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel, made repairs; and next to him, Zadok son of Baana made repairs as well.
translations.kjv: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
translations.asv: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
